method: two runs of 5 pairs of processes each, in alternating order, pinned to one CPU; each process: 2 warmup and 7 measured batches; best = minimum batch over all 10 processes of a port; median = median of process medians; instructions per round = (callgrind count with R rounds - count with 0 rounds) / R, one batch, no warmup

startup.probe: bench.py 0 1 0 (startup, input creation and validation; no timed rounds)

scope: AOT executables of bench/json_repair/{bench,facade,scaling}.py built by one compiler from two ports: old = ports/json_repair at b2182a4f (the 0.64.8 rewrite), new = the port re-based on upstream 0.64.9. Both are compared with each other, not with upstream under CPython.
